title: Stanford Professor Reveals “Praxis” Bitcoin Cryptography Breakthrough
summary: ▶ Bitcoin Magazine Stanford Professor Reveals “Praxis” Bitcoin Cryptography Breakthrough Bitcoin developers have tried for five to 10 years to add covenants through a soft fork, and every effort has stalled.
